criterion_bindings.exemption: Client registration is a transport-layer property below scenario grain. The guarantee is proved by TestCommandBoundaryRejectsInvalidTrailingJSONAcrossCommands (cmd/concord/main_test.go) and TestCLIEndToEndRegistersClientAndInvokesRead (cmd/concord/main_test.go).

Secret non-exposure is a transport invariant. CD-0080 removes the grant token, so the remaining secret is the registered client key. The guarantee is proved by TestInvokeRejectsUnknownFieldWithoutEcho (cmd/concord/main_test.go) and TestAuthorityRefusalsCarryTheUnauthorizedKind (internal/agent/authority_refusal_kind_test.go).

Single-envelope stdout is a transport property. The guarantee is proved by TestDecodeInvokeRequestRejectsInvalidTrailingJSON (internal/agent/runtime_test.go) and the adapter contract tests (adapter/opencode/generated-contract-tests.ts).
Same-key retry is a dispatch property. The guarantee is proved by TestDispatchIdempotentReplaySurvivesAmbientScopeDrift (internal/agent/mutation_dispatch_test.go).

Operator questions use the host question tool, not a transport bridge. TestConfirmPremiseEnvelopeKeepsThePublishedWireFormat (internal/agent/confirm_premise_wire_test.go) checks that choice and digest inputs are absent and refused.

summary: Binds the OpenCode adapter to generated tool registration through a plugin entry and short-lived Go CLI transport; domain authority remains in the Go core.
